gold.evidence_quote: estimates that integration costs can add USD 0.028–0.032/kWh to the cost of variable renewables at high penetration levels
it ignores the expenditures incurred beyond the limits of the plant

answer: At high penetration in Australia, integration costs of variable renewables can add up to about 3 AU¢/kWh. Plant-level LCOE does not capture them because it measures only the levelized cost of generation for an individual plant and omits system-level costs such as grid reinforcement, balancing (flexible generation, storage), reserve capacity, congestion, and additional transmission and curtailment costs required to integrate variable output into the power system.
